personality.description: This person tends to stick with familiar routines, avoids experimenting with unfamiliar ideas, and often drifts into disorganization or last-minute scrambling. In daily life, they may act on impulse rather than plan carefully, while also remaining guarded and suspicious of others’ intentions. When faced with a moral dilemma, they usually weigh it through a personal, self-protective lens, become tense quickly, and may fixate on possible negative outcomes or unfairness. In group discussions, they speak sparingly, prefer small or familiar settings, and can sound cautious, reserved, or sharply critical when they do contribute.
traits: has assertively moved up the ranks into positions of leadership
prioritizes having control and authority over others
makes quick and definitive decisions, and once a decision is made it is usually final
has their own views of how tasks should be accomplished
uses reward and punishment to get people to follow their ideas
